# P16 progress — uncertainty group saved and checked

The approved uncertainty plan is executed through sections 1–6 and UC01–UC19.

independent substantive review. Five counterpart contracts, initial-profile
selection, integrated acceptance/order and fourteen decisions remain unresolved.

registry closure/bindings, unchanged parent state and rejection receipts were
checked. The registered checker returns 1 with only `whole architecture contracts`
reported (237/238 pass), before later profile checks. Full-phase checks are thus
incomplete, not nearly accepted. Final structural refresh follows this status save.

uncertainty-verification-v1.json, uncertainty-structural-check-v1/v2.json, their
execution records and uncertainty-final-integrity-v1.json under
docs/design/proposal/architecture/; P16 architecture.json, result.md and this file.
No production code, controller or tests changed. Source/prototype evidence is
preserved. Product implementation stays disabled; human acceptance is pending.

uncertainty-structural-check-v2.json in the architecture directory.
Next task: independent substantive review of the completed bounded uncertainty
group, repair any findings, then plan accounting/state transitions. No unfinished
uncertainty subsection is knowingly deferred; continuous/mixed inference, causal
methods and calibration are explicit P17 capabilities requiring further research.
